## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (types, lint, tests)
- [ ] New mutations use `guardedAction` with a permission + Zod schema
- [ ] Changes are written to the audit log
- [ ] Inputs validated on client **and** server
- [ ] Works on mobile width and in dark mode
- [ ] Migration committed (if the schema changed) and seed updated
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes
